trust_decision.summary: Bound parameter values are rendered client-side into ClickHouse string literals by escapeValue/substituteParameters; the escaping (quote-doubling only) decides whether a value stays data, but ClickHouse also honours backslash escapes, so a trailing backslash ends the literal early.

landing_point.why: Advisory names parameter escaping, and the published CHANGELOG names escapeValue() in src/core/utils.ts; the string branch is the obvious place to look.

fix_sites.entry_point: Same entry points with object/array parameter values (JSON branch); fix.diff:657-665
ClickHouseAdapter.query(sql, params) / expr.raw(sql, params) with '?' inside quoted text; fix.diff:673-675

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/clickhouse/src/core/adapters/clickhouse-adapter.ts:42-67 (ClickHouseAdapter.query/stream/render call substituteParameters directly with caller SQL and params); also the JSON serializer branch packages/clickhouse/src/core/utils.ts:12

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The measure-filter literal renderers in @hypequery/datasets and @hypequery/serve live in other packages, have their own literal function, and take values from developer-authored measure definitions rather than request input, so a solver can call them 'not parameter escaping'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate values containing quotes or backslashes (O'Reilly, Windows paths, LIKE patterns, JSON objects) must still round-trip as literals, and '?' inside quoted text in raw SQL must not count as a placeholder; rejecting such values, or throwing on any backslash, breaks normal filtering.

O6_input_shapes: '?' inside string literal, quoted identifier, heredoc or comment in raw SQL shifting placeholder binding (fix.diff:673-675, fix.diff:830-851)

O7_producer.where: packages/clickhouse/src/core/utils.ts:12 (JSON.stringify of object/array params placed straight into a literal)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Measure-filter literals in @hypequery/datasets are rendered with quote-doubling only (no backslash escaping), reached via applyAggregationSpec for filtered measures.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate package with its own renderer; values come from developer-written measure definitions, not bound query parameters.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (datasets) from landing point (clickhouse); called from packages/datasets/src/query-planner.ts:68

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Duplicate measure-filter literal renderer in @hypequery/serve, same quote-only escaping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lives in the HTTP serve layer's semantic copy; looks like a mirror of the datasets package rather than the parameter path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A cache-key or log renderer with its own inline literal quoting instead of substituteParameters.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The cache path already renders SQL separately for keys; a maintainer optimizing key stability could inline a quick quote-doubling helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Tenant scope injected as a pre-rendered literal string (e.g. via a raw where) rather than a bound value.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tenant auto-injection sits next to the measure-filter renderer that already builds literals by hand; reusing renderMeasureFilterLiteral there is a plausible shortcut.

O9_family: CWE-89 SQL injection via incomplete client-side string-literal escaping (backslash escape not neutralised; JSON branch unescaped; placeholder parser differential)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm workspaces monorepo; vitest (packages/clickhouse/vitest.config.ts); build script at packages/clickhouse/package.json:25
O10_build.project_tests: packages/clickhouse/src/core/tests/*.test.ts (unit tests assert rendered SQL via toSQL/substituteParameters, e.g. query-builder.where.test.ts); integration tests under src/core/tests/integration need a ClickHouse server and are skippable

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\') to the string branch of escapeValue only, leaving the JSON branch, the naive '?' split and the datasets/serve measure-filter renderers untouched.
